RAG-H2-03: The ratified charter defines five tests: exit, code, audit, governance and fork. Each implementation requires its own evidence. Public verification keys and signed daily audit roots are not yet provisioned; charter requirements do not certify deployed services.
RAG-H2-06: SureEvidence specifies digital record integrity, issuer provenance and verification references. The reference software can check signed data. Legal admissibility, lawful issuance and compliance with Evidence Act requirements depend on the record, responsible institution and applicable proceedings.
RAG-H2-07: ClearAm specifies purpose, scope, expiry and revocation envelopes. The reference software checks those controls locally. A deployment must separately establish lawful processing and measure revocation performance; no live under-60-second service is certified here.
RAG-H2-08: Confluence specifies safe retries, idempotency and preservation of uncertain outcomes. The reference implementation tests those state transitions locally. The commons operates no payment switch; service availability and actual settlement behavior require operator evidence.
RAG-H2-09: MarketLink specifies open exchange formats and participant relationships. The commons operates no marketplace, haulage service or commission gateway. Adoption and interoperability must be verified for each implementation.
RAG-H2-10: GivePower specifies bounded delegation, human approval and auditability. Reference checks enforce permission boundaries. These controls cannot grant powers absent from the responsible institution or change official records without lawful authority.
RAG-H2-11: KioskBase specifies local records and synchronization during network interruptions. Reference merge tests run locally. Operational 2G access, feature-phone channels and public registry continuity require separate deployment evidence.
RAG-H2-12: LawTree specifies structured legal text and language review. Official legal sources retain authority. Translations of statutory and consent text require legal and linguistic approval before authoritative publication.
RAG-H2-13: The Local Government Stack specifies fourteen municipal service modules, source custody and direct settlement constraints. Registry coverage does not prove service deployment, lawful collection, fiscal compliance or USSD availability. Each operator must provide its own implementation evidence.
